item.title: Harrisonville police ask for assistance regarding missing person
item.description: Daniel Potter has not been seen since December 22nd, at about 10:00 pm. He was last seen leaving his residence near Independence and Polk. Please contact the Harrisonville Police Department if you have any information on Daniel's whereabouts. 816-390-8940

item.title: Obituary - Larry Gene Shepard
item.description: Larry Gene Shepard age 76, of Appleton City Missouri, passed away Friday December 26, 2025, at home surrounded by his loved ones. He was born November 3, 1949, in Clinton Missouri to Elmore and Abby (McIntire) Shepard. He grew up on a farm in Johnson City, Missouri, where he learned about the life of farming and gardening at a young age. He graduated from Appleton City High School in 1967. item.title: Competitor of the Week Brittany Mallatt
item.description: Congratulations to our Competitor of the Week for 12/15/25–12/21/25, Brittany Mallatt!Brittany was nominated for her dominance on the mat so far this season. She has shown impressive growth and continued execution match after match. Brittany also dominates in the classroom, showing her all-around effort and determination. Keep it up, Brittany!

item.title: A Whirlwind of honors due
item.description: The Lady Whirlwinds are the 40th Annual Midway Tournament Champions, and the boys were the runner up. Thanks to all the fans that showed up to support both teams. Also, congrats to Lexie Andrews, Abigail Sutton, Malayna Baer, Jackson Kash, and Michael Stevenson for being selected to the all tournament team.
